queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN date_limite_non_reconduction < '2026-10-28' THEN 'depasse' WHEN date_limite_non_reconduction <= '2026-11-07' THEN 'urgent' WHEN date_limite_non_reconduction <= '2026-11-27' THEN 'a_examiner' ELSE 'ok' END AS niveau, COUNT(*) AS n FROM `contrats` WHERE `statut` IN ('en_execution','en_renouvellement') AND date_limite_non_reconduction IS NOT NULL AND id IN (SELECT `id` FROM `contrats`) GROUP BY `niveau`
